class.name: IfcRelConnectsWithRealizingElements
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : IfcRelConnectsWithRealizingElements defines a generic relationship that is made between two elements that require the realization of that relationship by means of further realizing elements. members.member: Defines the elements that realize a connection relationship.
The type of the connection given for informal purposes, it may include labels, like 'joint', 'rigid joint', 'flexible joint', etc.
